name: IC3 complaint-derived DPRK IT-worker victim-company scale

attribution.legal_posture: Official U.S. government aggregate or risk-assessment finding. Underlying pending case summaries remain allegations where applicable

caveats: Complaint-derived identification records an allegation or investigative lead; conviction status requires a court disposition, and investigations may be at different stages.
The April 6, 2026 date is corroborated by contemporaneous public reporting; the official report PDF and landing page provide no visible day-specific publication date.
The report omits exact victim-company number, loss total, worker names, company names, and incident-level case details.

statements: IC3 says it identified dozens of victim companies affected by the DPRK IT-worker scam through complaints submitted to IC3.gov.
The FBI says it observed DPRK IT workers use unlawful network access to exfiltrate proprietary and sensitive data and facilitate cyber-criminal activity on behalf of the DPRK.
The report describes the broader program as involving thousands of workers dispatched globally to obtain remote employment and generate weapons-program revenue.
